entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad

sentences.text:
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.
Heard Sri Ashok Kumar Upadhyay, learned counsel for the applicant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

2. The instant anticipatory bail application has been moved by the applicant for enlarging him on bail in Case No.474 of 2022 (FIR No.143 of 2015), arising out of Case Crime No.264 of 2015, under Sections 342 and 120-B I.P.C., Police Station Highway, District Mathura.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that earlier applicant moved Crl. Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.10549 of 2023 before this Hon'ble Court U/s 376, 511 I.P.C. and Section 7/8 of Mahendra Bhagwan Devlekar vs State Of Up 3 Others on 15 May, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/37301241/
1 POCSO Act and the anticipatory bail application has been rejected vide order dated 02.05.2024,
thereafter, during investigation, Sections 342 and 120-B I.P.C. have been added.

entities.text: Crl. Misc. Anticipatory Bail Application No.10549 of 2023
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

entities.text: Mahendra Bhagwan Devlekar vs State Of Up 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Since, earlier,
anticipatory bail was not filed U/s 342 and 120-B I.P.C., hence, this anticipatory bail application has been filed under the aforesaid section.

4. The object of Section 438 of the Code of Criminal Procedure is that a person should not be unnecessarily harassed or humiliated in order to satisfy personal vendetta or grudge of complainant or any other person operating the things directly or from behind the curtains.

5. It is well settled that discretionary power conferred by the legislature on this Court cannot be put in a straitjacket formula but such discretionary power either grant or refusal of anticipatory bail has to be exercised carefully in appropriate cases with circumspection on the basis of the available material after evaluating the facts of the particular case and considering other relevant factors (nature and gravity of accusation, role attributed to accused, conduct of accused, criminal antecedents, possibility of the applicant to flee from justice, apprehension of tempering of the witnesses or threat to the complainant, impact of grant of anticipatory bail in investigation or society etc.) with meticulous precision maintaining balance between the conflicting interest, namely,
sanctity of individual liberty and interest of society.

6. Without expressing any opinion on merits of the case and considering the submissions advanced,
the nature and gravity of the accusation, I find no good ground for anticipatory bail to the applicant in the aforesaid case as in the main sections, applicant's anticipatory bail has been rejected.
7. Accordingly, the anticipatory bail application is rejected.

8. However, if the applicant surrender before the concerned court within three weeks from today and applies for bail, the bail application shall be decided expeditiously by the court concerned, in accordance with law laid down by the Apex Court in Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC OnLine SC 922.
9.

entities.text: Satender Kumar Antil Vs. Central Bureau of Investigation and another, reported in 2021 SCC OnLine SC 922
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Till three weeks from today or till surrender of the applicant before court concerned, whichever is earlier, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicant.
